{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows
print(sales_df.head())

# Display basic info
print(sales_df.info())

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()
print("Missing values:\n", missing_values)

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate rows: {duplicates}")

# Display unique values for key columns
print("\nUnique values in 'campaign':", sales_df['campaign'].unique())
print("Unique values in 'region':", sales_df['region'].unique())
print("Unique values in 'sales':", sales_df['sales'].unique())

# Summary statistics for sales
print("\nSales summary statistics:")
print(sales_df['sales'].describe())"}
